title: CEBORY 3-IN-1 Electric Stand Mixer, 6.5QT Bowl 660W 10-Speed Kitchen Mixer, Household Food Mixers include Dough Hook, Beater and Whisk, Bread Cake Mixer for Baking and Most Home Cooks, Almond Cream Review
reviews: Buy this NOW! I have been searching for the perfect mixer for various baking scenarios and bought one and returned it that was more expensive than this one. I am VERY well pleased with this purchase. For starters it is easy to operate I didn't have to read the instructions, I love that it suctions to my counter for easy and reduced mess. The attachments are very simple and easy to remove and the bowl removal is also easy and ideal for baking bread, making anything you need a mixer for. I have made several loafs of bread and home made donuts with this and it has eliminated the hand kneading and reduced time involved. The motor works well and it is overall a very good buy. I have the black one but the red is one I considered. It's very well made and the quality is top notch!

Works Great The kitchen mixer arrived in a well protected package. It looks nice and cute. No installation needed, which is great. It’s super easy to use it. Just plug in the charger and turn the speed button to the number you need. So far I only use the speed No. 1 to make my steam stuffed bun dough. It works great! My hands are released from kneading flour. The mixer comes with 3 different mixing heads. Each has its own function. There are four strong suction cups on the bottom to make the machine stable while it’s operating. Overall, it worth its money. Very good kitchen machine. Strongly recommended!
Good quality works great Was a gift worked great for the baker in my family.

CEBORY Stand Mixer - MISSING THE BEATER attachment Although shipping was delayed, I was pleasantly surprised with the mixer itself. It’s a little light weight, yet sturdy. It’s a nice looking mixer and looks pretty easy to operate. It’s a nice size compared to the top of the line Kitchen Aid. The mixing bowl is really deep. Unfortunately, when putting the mixer together, I noticed that the “beater” attachment was missing. I’m not sure if this was a returned item, but I was very disappointed that one of the main components was missing. As pictured in the photo above, there was only 2 attachments and it should have been 3. I gave it a 4 because the quality appears to be good. However, I never got a chance to actually use it because it was missing the “beater.” I’m hoping they’ll ship another one right away. I was so looking forward to using this. Just disappointed at this point.

Glad I found this mixer, great alternate I've to more expensive, heavier models. I used to work at Williams Sonoma and naturally the Kitchenaid miixer.was very popular. But at the time I didn't really have much of a need for it. But lately I have been thinking of making more bread, other baked goods, but still not want something as expensive and heavy..I have a bad back and don't plan on displaying this on my counter. I wanted something light weight to pull out and put away. Arrived quickly and in great shape. I Love the color, which other brands don't offer. And it really is a beautiful shape, size, design.. I wanted to make some banana bread as a gift to a neighbor and while I don't usually even use my hand mixer for that I decided to use my new mixer to test it out. I would say it meets my expectations. It is easy to use and not too noisy. The bowl is tall and has a low profile which will be nice for storage, doesn't leave much room for scraping down the sides or for adding ingredients. I only used the whisk attachment as the batter would not require kneading and it managed the two cups of flour easily.. My mom's old mixer from the 50's had two beaters and the bowl turned so you could scrap down the sides. I do kind of wish the bowl turned as I had to stop and raise whisk to do that. I think it will just take a little getting used to. I didn't use the splatter shield this time but I can see where it might come in handy. I also think a handle on the bowl would be helpful. It was awkwad to pour the batter into the loaf pan. I would recommend this mixer for anyone who wants something that looks pretty, is light weight, works very well, and saves money. Very good value. I will update this review once I make some smash icy or honey wheat bread, etc.
Good price for a good product So far so good, I love my dough mixer .it saves me a lot of time price is very reasonable

Solid mixer for home kitchen! I’ve been loving this mixer so far. The 6.5QT bowl is a great size — big enough for bread dough or cake batter but not so bulky it takes over the counter. The 660W motor feels powerful, and the 10 speeds make it easy to switch between whipping cream and kneading dough. The included dough hook, whisk, and beater cover all the basics, and they’re simple to swap out. It does get a little noisy on higher speeds, but that’s normal for a mixer with this much power. Cleanup is pretty easy, and the purple color adds a fun pop to the kitchen. Overall, it feels sturdy, works well, and has handled everything I’ve thrown at it. For the price, it’s a really solid choice for most home cooks.

Good buy So far, so good. My husband bought this because I had been looking at them for making marshmallows. I was so excited when it arrived. It's not the biggest of mixers, but will definitely work for my baking needs. All the attachments go on easy and stay on. It has good suction feet so it stays in place. The arm lifts nicely for putting on the attachments or removing the bowl. I'm very glad to have this.
